news.title: Bitcoin slides to 3-month low of $65,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
news.summary: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

news.title: Ethereum scaling project MegaETH slashes staff by 20% as it pursues AI business
news.summary: Decentralized Finance total value locked on MegaETH dropped significantly from over $245 million to $8.8 million.

news.title: Britain could turn wasted Scottish wind power into bitcoin to cut its $1.3 billion grid bill
news.summary: Britain could use bitcoin mining to absorb surplus Scottish wind power and reduce payments to wind farms to halt generation, according to a Bitcoin Policy Institute report.

news.title: A behind the scenes force may amplify bitcoin and ether price volatility
news.summary: Both bitcoin and ether are trading in price ranges where market makers and dealers may add to market volatility.

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

news.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
news.summary: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.

news.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
news.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.

news.title: 米上場ナカモト、ビットコイン評価益で黒字も調整後営業損益は赤字
news.summary: ビットコイン・トレジャリー企業ナカモトが2026年7〜9月期の決算を発表。BTC評価益により純利益8,550万ドルの黒字となった。営業収益はマイナス190万ドルだった。

news.title: Satoshi-era wallet served in a $260 billion lawsuit moves 75 BTC it held since 2011
news.summary: The roughly $5 million transfer also spent the tiny payment used to deliver a court notice to the address in May.

news.title: アダム・バック、ビットコインが2028年までに100万ドル到達の可能性
news.summary: ブロックストリームのアダム・バックCEOがCNBCのインタビューで、ビットコインが2028年までに100万ドルに達する可能性に言及した。機関投資家の採用余地の95％以上がこれからだとして、長期的強気相場の序盤にあるとの認識を示した。

news.title: ストラテジーCEO「MSCI指数連動の株式はわずか3％で除外の影響は限定的」
news.summary: 仮想通貨ビットコインの保有大手ストラテジーのCEOは13日、MSCIの指数に連動する同社株はわずか3％で、除外の影響は小さいとの見方を示した。MSCIは11月30日に同社を指数から除外する。

news.title: ビットコイン7万ドル割れ、AI株安が波及しロング大量清算が下落を加速｜仮想NISHI
news.summary: 仮想通貨ビットコインは13日から14日にかけて大きく下落し、2日間で円建て100万円幅を超える下げとなった。米追加利上げへの警戒から買いが弱まるなか、エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアンCEO辞任を受けたハイテク株への不安が重なった。

news.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
news.summary: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

news.title: 米上場Twenty One Capital第3四半期決算、ビットコイン評価益で10億ドル超の黒字
news.summary: テザーが支援する米上場企業Twenty One Capitalが13日、第3四半期の純利益が10億8,675万ドルだったと発表した。ほぼ全てがビットコインの評価益で、1〜9月期は1億8,648万ドルの純損失だった。

news.title: Adam Back makes case for simpler security as Blockstream launches Bitcoin custody system
news.summary: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.

news.title: JPモルガン、ストラテジー株を36％積み増し、仮想通貨関連保有は1600億円近く
news.summary: 米銀大手JPモルガン・チェースの13F提出書類で、9月30日時点のビットコイン現物ETF、ストラテジー、コインベースの保有が合計約9億8,100万ドルと判明した。第3四半期にはストラテジー株を36％積み増した。

news.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
news.summary: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

news.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
news.summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

news.title: Bitcoin holds below $70K as stocks slip despite a cooler US PPI print
news.summary: Bitcoin was down about 4% on the day amid a tepid market reaction to October’s US PPI reading, which came in below expected levels.

news.title: Bitcoin heads for sixth weekly loss as Anthropic’s blockbuster IPO looms
news.summary: Bitcoin is down 21% this year as investors weigh Anthropic’s anticipated listing, Nvidia’s leadership upheaval and rising Fed rate hike expectations.

news.title: Nakamoto shares fall 6% premarket after Q3 revenue turns negative
news.summary: A $5.8 million Bitcoin options loss pushed Nakamoto’s quarterly operating revenue below zero, while the company extended repayment of $60 million in Kraken debt to 2027.

news.title: メタプラネット決算、ビットコイン売却損などで純損益が赤字に
news.summary: 東証スタンダード上場のメタプラネットが、10月14日から11月12日に累計約283億円の自社株買いを実施した。決算では1月から9月は純損失約272億円で、米スーパー・リーグ・エンタープライズへの戦略投資も予定している。

news.title: Bitcoin's momentum gauge is turning red, could send prices back below $60,000
news.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 13, 2026

news.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 for the first time since August and is down 3.5% since midnight UTC, as the dollar climbs and liquidations top $1.6 billion.

news.title: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next
news.summary: Bitcoin price action interacted with its 200-week simple moving average for the first time since mid-August as it fell below $68,000.
